description: Tamil Nadu to unveil policies on Deep Tech and AI, focusing on innovation and economic growth with a Deep Tech Fund.
body_lead: Minister for Information Technology and Digital Services Palanivel Thiaga Rajan on Thursday said Tamil Nadu will soon unveil policies on Deep Tech and Artificial Intelligence (AI), besides mulling a Deep Tech Fund. “In the recent discussion on Demands for Grant for the IT and Digital Services Department in the Assembly, we also spoke about a mantra or slogan — Innovate in Tamil Nadu. As we are the most industrialised State with the greatest of talent pool, we need to use the innovation approach to stimulate our economy and achieve the Chief Minister M.K.
